metadata.principle: Targeted public-source research did not verify a current public HRM invoice-, cheque-, accounts-payable-, or vendor-payment-level ledger. This is not proof that such records do not exist internally or cannot be released through routine access or an access-to-information request. Procurement awards, budget authority, contract amendments, quarterly summaries and audited actuals must not be relabelled as payments.

verified_process_evidence.title: Standard Terms and Conditions for Goods and Services
verified_process_evidence.finding: HRM requires purchase-order information on supplier invoices and administers payments through an electronic payment process; undisputed properly rendered invoices are generally payable 30 days from invoice date, subject to HRM verification.

verified_process_evidence.title: 2015/16 Budget and Business Plan - Finance & ICT
verified_process_evidence.finding: The Finance function explicitly described Accounts Payable Processing as recording approved invoices and paying vendors for HRM, Library and various agencies, boards and commissions.

public_source_boundary_evidence.title: Awarded Public Tenders
public_source_boundary_evidence.finding: This source provides tender award/vendor/award-amount evidence. Award value is not evidence that an invoice was submitted or that HRM paid that amount.

public_source_boundary_evidence.title: Halifax Open Data program
public_source_boundary_evidence.finding: HRM maintains an active Open Data program. Targeted Build 019 searches of public HRM/Open Data surfaces did not verify a vendor-payment, cheque-register, invoice-level or accounts-payable transaction dataset.

preferred_sequence: Submit an informal/routine-access request to the appropriate HRM business unit for a machine-readable accounts-payable/vendor-payment export.
If HRM advises that the records are not routinely available, file an access-to-information request under Part XX of the Municipal Government Act.

Request an electronic machine-readable release and a data dictionary/code list; HRM access materials state electronic records are typically supplied as PDF or Excel depending on the records and file size.

official_guidance.title: Access, Privacy & Requesting Information
official_guidance.finding: HRM directs requesters to start with an informal request to the relevant business unit and use an access request if the information is not routinely available.

official_guidance.title: Form 1 - Access to Information Application
official_guidance.finding: The form supports requesting electronic copies; it states electronic records are typically provided in PDF or Excel format.

access_path.requested_record_scope: A machine-readable extract of HRM accounts-payable/vendor-payment records for the longest practical retention period, one row per releasable payment/disbursement or invoice-payment event, including stable document identifiers and organizational/procurement/project coding. Exclude banking information, tax identifiers, personal addresses and other protected personal or confidential information.
access_path.fallback_scope: If invoice identifiers or line-level details cannot be released, request the most granular releasable vendor/payment data containing a stable payment/document identifier, payee, payment date, amount, purchase-order/contract/tender reference, cost centre/business unit, account/category and capital project code where applicable.

privacy_and_security_exclusions: other protected personal information not necessary for public-money reconciliation
